blocks.text:
On arrival in Rio de Janeiro, your guide will meet you at the airport and take you to your hotel.

Brazil’s second-largest city, Rio is famous for its green hills, beautiful bays, islands and long ocean beaches. The best known are Copacabana, Ipanema and Leblon.

A black-and-white mosaic promenade stretches along Copacabana. From early morning until late at night, people play football and volleyball on the sand, exercise or simply relax by the sea.

For an active holiday, Rio offers surfing, diving, tennis, golf, rafting, hang-gliding and many other activities.

Open-air beach cafés serve coconut water, freshly squeezed juices and cold drinks; you may also hear local musicians performing nearby.

After your transfer, check in and relax.
